components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single highest-value action inside a workbench region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; border: 0; border-radius: 1.05rem; background: var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)); color: var(--color-workbench-accent-ink, oklch(21% 0.024 142)); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(80% 0.12 142); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral command button for repeated operational actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-workbench-border, oklch(42% 0.018 82)); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-workbench-panel-strong, oklch(30% 0.018 82)); color: var(--color-workbench-text, oklch(90% 0.018 85)); padding: 0.625rem 1rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(54% 0.02 82); background: oklch(34% 0.018 82); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Deep path, search, and name field with clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-workbench-muted, oklch(68% 0.018 86)); font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-input { min-height: 3rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-workbench-border, oklch(42% 0.018 82)); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--legacy-surface, #0f172a); color: var(--color-workbench-text, oklch(90% 0.018 85)); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Icon plus text rail item with explicit active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 2.4rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)) 52%, var(--color-workbench-border, oklch(42% 0.018 82))); border-radius: 0.9rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)) 17%, var(--color-workbench-panel, oklch(25% 0.016 83))); color: var(--color-workbench-text, oklch(90% 0.018 85)); padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-workbench-panel-strong, oklch(30% 0.018 82)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small source, state, or ownership label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-workbench-accent, oklch(73% 0.13 142)) 15%, transparent); color: oklch(86% 0.06 142); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: This interface should feel like a precise desktop workbench for a technical operator: calm, legible, and ready for repeated use. The system rejects SaaS landing-page drama, decorative AI-tool styling, and settings-page sprawl.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark workbench surfaces with one restrained green primary accent.
Compact expert density with real breathing room between functional regions.
Flat-by-default surfaces, using border and tone before shadow.
Direct action language and visible ownership labels.
Clear separation between configuration, preview, and filesystem mutation.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Bench Signal Green is the primary system voice. Do not let sky, cyan, amber, violet, and rose all compete on the same screen.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Use color to label state, not to decorate. If a color does not tell the user what changed, what is selected, or what is risky, remove it.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels are for orientation, not decoration. They must be short, muted, and paired with stronger content beneath them.

rules.name: The Flat First Rule
rules.body: Do not add a shadow when a border, background tone, or spacing change can separate the element.

dos: Do show state before action: previews, counts, managed/unmanaged labels, stale references, dirty markers, and target paths should appear before apply buttons.
Do keep configuration and mutation distinct.
Do use borders, tone, grouping, and concise labels to make dense screens readable.
Do keep primary actions rare per region, with one clear action color.
Do preserve keyboard focus states, bilingual label fit, and scroll regions that do not clip outlines or content.
donts: Don't make it feel like a SaaS landing page, decorative AI product demo, or marketing dashboard.
Don't overuse cards. Do not nest cards inside cards.
Don't use ornamental gradients, vanity metrics, hero sections, or promotional copy inside the app shell.
Don't use colored side stripes, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or full-screen accent color unless a future task explicitly changes the design register.
